summary: Crow's nest lookout in 1929, 75 ft steel tower in 1932, moved to Goat Mtn. in 1967; a 2012 visit found a cell tower where it stood.

facts.design: 75 ft steel tower with 7x7 ft cab and cabin (1932), after a 1929 crow's nest and camp
facts.status_note: Tower moved to Goat Mtn. in 1967; a 2012 visitor found a cell phone tower standing where the lookout had been

access.note: A 2012 trip report describes driving gravel Road 290 or hiking to the site. No current source.

visit.trail_note: 2012 report: the site can be hiked to or driven to. Road 290 is 2.5 miles of gravel, the last half rough. No trail details given.

events.note: Crow's nest lookout and camp constructed.
Telephone line of about two and a half miles built from Frog Lake Campground to the summit.
Forest guard camped at Frog Lake Campground and spent the day observing from the summit.
75 ft steel tower with 7x7 ft cab and cabin replaced the crow's nest.
Panorama photos taken by Robert Cooper.
Tower moved to Goat Mtn. to serve as a radio tower. Sources do not say which Goat Mountain.
Visitor found a cell phone tower standing where the lookout had been.

notes_for_editor: Brief's registration date (Aug 24, 2010) is not in the cached FFLOS text (the date field is blank in extraction), so it is not used here. The FFLOS photo caption 'Building currently on site 10/27/2002' does not say what building it is, so it is not used. Goat Mtn. is not located in any source; WebSearch returned only Goat Mountain pages in other states, none tied to this tower. height_m is 75 ft converted to metres. The 'public' access level rests on a single 2012 visit. Two WebSearch calls used.
